subject: Mapping data in two separate data frames

messages.author: 0d5c994b344af3a8
messages.subject: Mapping data in two separate data frames
parts:
Hi All

I have a data frame consisting of individuals with two key variable names
(i) ID (ii) Year-Quarter in which they were questioned. This is of the form "2009-Q1"

My second data frame consists of economic data with two variable names
(i)Year-Quarter (ii) GDP growth rate

I want to create a single data frame where I want to map an individual with economic growth rates in time period t, (t-1), (t-2), (t+1), (t+2). I can do it manually and very easily in excel. But I wonder if there is an elegant way to do it in R. 

Thanks for your help/

messages.author: 4b16035cff9b0f8a
messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: Mapping data in two separate data frames
parts:
Somebody may have a more elegant solution to the calculation problem, but as long as the data frame isn't huge (this is a very computationally expensive method because it goes through the data frame row by row), here's how I'd solve it.


growthcalc <- function(dtf,n){
  dtf$out <- NA
   for (i in 1:nrow(dtf)){
    dtf[i,"out"] <- dtf[i+n,"growth"]
 }
  return(dtf$out)
}

growth$growth_minus1 <- growthcalc(growth, -1)
growth$growth_plus1 <- growthcalc(growth, 1)

etc

This requires the GDP dates to be in order.

Then you'd do the merge.
